capabilities: Look up words in local MDX dictionaries
Render entries with the dictionary's own CSS
Record sentence, book, author and timestamp per lookup
Edit a saved word and re-run its lookup
Export selected words to HTML or PDF
disambiguation: Not for MDX (Markdown + JSX) files; MDX here means the MDict .mdx dictionary format.
extras: Desktop only (Windows/macOS/Linux), no mobile support. Fully offline with no network requests. MIT licensed; MDX parsing uses js-mdict v6.0.8. Early access installable through BRAT.
intentEvidence: this plugin brings that same experience into Obsidian
motivation: The author wanted the e-reader habit of tapping a word, looking it up and exporting a vocabulary list when a book is finished to work inside Obsidian, where the books already are.
problem: Reading books as Markdown notes in Obsidian gives no built-in way to look up unknown words or collect them into a vocabulary list.
summary: Offline dictionary lookup that shows MDX definitions in a popup and saves each word with its sentence, book and author for export.
